name: Kamijou Asumi
source:
A woman in her early 20’s who decides to travel to Tokyo in order to locate her older sister, whom she has not heard from in several months. Her journey to find her sister takes place primarily around Mikozuka Lab, a university-run facility where her sister supposedly works. 

[From [url=http://www.indienavi.com/2014/03/25/a-scar-of-the-doll-hands-on-impressions-an-immersive-adventure-with-some-rough-edges/]IndieNavi[/url]]
